provenance_note: Official response of the National Diet Library's Diet minutes API (JSON, UTF-8), served with Cache-Control: no-cache, no-store; the JSON carries no timestamp, session token or request echo, so it is not generated per request. Found by the part A check, which downloaded it at 13:08:36Z (plain and with a cache-busting query) and again at 13:39:44Z on 25 September 2026, each time with the same byte count and SHA-256. Downloaded on 25 September 2026 (UTC) by this packet at 14:19:01Z and 14:55:33Z, 36 minutes apart, and at 14:57:28Z (cache-busting query), each time with the same byte count and SHA-256; at least two downloads were 30 minutes or more apart. Bytes and SHA-256 are of the identity-encoded body, requested without Accept-Encoding (the Diet API and the Internet Archive send gzip when a client asks for it, which changes the transferred bytes but not the content). This checked-in file is a derived factual extract, not a copy of the original response. Original response bodies, PDFs, images and page renders are not checked into this repository. Its own checksum is recorded separately in the packet.
rights_note: Factual observations paraphrased with attribution; short quotations only. No photographs, emblems, seals, signatures, scanned pages or long speech text copied. No open license, portrait permission or likeness approval is asserted.
scope_note: The Diet minutes API's JSON for the whole meeting record of the 衆議院 予算委員会 第5号 (1992-02-20), a transcription of the House's printed minutes; the exact API URL whose bytes were hashed is recorded, and the readable minutes page is https://kokkai.ndl.go.jp/txt/112305261X00519920220. The printed page images, served through a JavaScript viewer, were not viewed. Statements are used only where a party officer speaks of the party office.

visual_review.method: Machine-readable minute text read in full for the cited speeches and the surrounding questions; the printed page images were not viewed.

rows.text: In the House of Representatives Budget Committee on 20 February 1992, 宮澤 (printed ○宮澤内閣総理大臣) referred to the presidential election held in October and November of the previous year (昨年の十月、十一月に行われました総裁選挙), which he said he had experienced himself.

Asked the same day by 草川昭三 about his standpoint 'as president of the LDP' (自民党の総裁としてのお立場), 宮澤 answered that it would be better to speak from the president's side, setting aside for a moment that he was Prime Minister (総裁の方であるとよろしゅうございますが、総理ということをちょっと一度別にして).

bounded_scope: Party-office observations of the LDP president (総裁) for CLAUDE-C01-18 only, 1990-2009 (stacked on CLAUDE-C01-13). Party elections and selections (member and Diet-member votes, joint plenary meetings of party Diet members), notices, candidacies, declarations and reports of results, statements of assumption, in-office attestations, announced and prospective resignations, predecessor references and retrospective records stay separate rows; holder boundaries are decided in the packet, not by any row. A null holder_name means the source names no holder of this office (a notice, a filing, a schedule, an unnamed caption or a meeting). The prime-ministership (jp_pm) is excluded: no row feeds it, and no jp_pm claim feeds this office.
